_: The two AI engines this stage declares for C4b and C5b. One file, read by config/llm/engines.py, so the interface can offer a choice of engine without a code change (submission checklist item 9) and the run manifest can record which one produced a row. Selecting an engine sets a default per role; an explicitly set model variable still wins, which is how the A/B harnesses pin two models of one provider.
_default: The engine used when RDTII_ENGINE is unset is NOT this one: with no RDTII_ENGINE the stage keeps its pre-engine behaviour and reads LLM_PROVIDER and the four model variables directly. `default` is what an interface should preselect.
_roles: triage is always local (kickoff decision #3: a local model never maps, verifies or breaks a tie, and the cheap screen is local-first), so both engines name the same triage model and the factory forces its provider.
